advancements.steveparty.guide.lay_the_bo: Place a Tile, an Advanced Tile or a Checkpoint
advancements.steveparty.guide.make_a_paw: Get a Tokenizer Wand or a Token
advancements.steveparty.guide.mini_games: Get a Mini-Game Page or place a Mini-game Controller
Get a Shopkeeper Key or place a Trading Stall
advancements.steveparty.guide.root.descr: Get Plastic Pellets or a first board item
advancements.steveparty.guide.root.title: Steve Party Maker
[#](1C4E80)**Redstone**[#]() picks the cartridge that plays.\
\
Power 0 = slot 1, 1 = slot 2…

Role, colour and destinations follow the active cartridge.\
\
A comparator or a counter: the space changes every turn.
book.steveparty.guide.board.board_view.p:
[#](1C4E80)**Linker Brush**[#]() in hand: every link shows.
- [#](1C4E80)**Start**[#]()
- [#](B8860B)**?**[#]() at forks
- [#](C0392B)**!**[#]() at dead ends
- [#](D2691E)**!**[#]() if unreachable

[#](1C4E80)**Status**[#]() tab of the [#](1C4E80)**Party Controller**[#](), or [#](9A6A00)/steveparty board check[#]().\
\
No start, dead ends, empty shops…
book.steveparty.guide.board.explorer_hel:
- A panel on each space within 8 blocks
- Its destinations in [#](2E7D32)**green**[#]()
- What leads there in [#](2F7FE0)**blue**[#]()
- Its chests in [#](B8860B)**gold**[#]()
[#](9A6A00)G[#](): turns its lamp on or off. It doesn't protect.
- [#](1C4E80)**Play**[#](), empty hand: the panel
- [#](1C4E80)**Build**[#](), tool in hand: the settings
- [#](1C4E80)**Explorer**[#](), helmet on: the whole board
book.steveparty.guide.board.linking.desc: Paint the path with the brush
book.steveparty.guide.board.linking.name: Linking Spaces
book.steveparty.guide.board.linking.page:
[#](9A6A00)Hold right-click[#]() and sweep the spaces along the path.\
\
Sweep a link again: [#](C0392B)**erased**[#]().

[#](9A6A00)Left-click[#](): its wheel.
- **Default link** or **by power**
- **Mode**: keep or put a cartridge
- **Undo** / **Redo**

- to a [#](1C4E80)**space**[#](): a destination
- to a [#](1C4E80)**chest**[#](): its storage
- to a [#](1C4E80)**Spawn Bubble**[#](): where its mob appears
- [#](1C4E80)**Magpie Nest**[#](): its pot

[#](3E8E2E)**[Linker]**[#](): links\
[#](5E9A50)**[Linkable]**[#](): gets linked\
\
[#](1C4E80)**Linker Brush**[#]() in off hand: each [#](1C4E80)**Tile**[#]() placed links to the last one.
book.steveparty.guide.board.moving.name: Moving on the Board
book.steveparty.guide.board.moving.page1:
Arrows appear: [#](9A6A00)right-click empty-handed[#]() on one.\
\
No steps left: the space triggers for the whole party.
book.steveparty.guide.board.name: The Board
book.steveparty.guide.board.placing.name: Placing Tiles
book.steveparty.guide.board.placing.page: It faces one of [#](1C4E80)**8 directions**[#](), following your look.

Tokens climb the slopes.

- On stairs: a ramp
- On a stair corner: diagonal
- On a slab, snow or carpet: on their surface
book.steveparty.guide.board.router.name: Redstone Router
book.steveparty.guide.board.router.page0:
Its spaces: linked with the [#](1C4E80)Tile Linker Brush[#](), from it to each.\
\
Its power [#](1C4E80)**replaces**[#]() theirs: one lever, a whole board.\
\
Its lever shows its power: leaning one way at 0, the other at 15. Its torch lights while it is powered.
book.steveparty.guide.board.router.page1:
- 15 plain · 14 bonus · 13 penalty
- 11 start · 10 Stop · 9 Roll Again
- 8 Teleport · 7 forward · 6 back
- 5 shop · 1 a token passes
book.steveparty.guide.board.sizes.name: Tile Sizes
- [#](1C4E80)**Small**[#](): 1 block
- [#](1C4E80)**Standard**[#](): 2×2 picture on its block
- [#](1C4E80)**Large**[#](): 2×2 blocks
2 small = 1 standard; 4 standard in a square = 1 large.
- It keeps cartridges, settings, look, size
- It [#](C0392B)**loses its links**[#]()
- With [#](2E7D32)**Silk Touch**[#](): links kept
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.name: Tiles & Checkpoints
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page0: A board is made of spaces. Their [#](1C4E80)**cartridges**[#]() give role and destinations.
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page1:
- [#](1C4E80)**Tile**[#](): 1 cartridge, 1 step
- [#](1C4E80)**Advanced Tile**[#](): 16 cartridges, redstone picks
- [#](1C4E80)**Checkpoint**[#](): 16 cartridges, [#](2E7D32)**0 steps**[#]()
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page2: The recipe's cartridge stays inside, as it was.
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page3:
At a crafting table:
- Tile + cartridge: replaced
- Tile alone: emptied
- Advanced tile + cartridges: free slots filled
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page4: A glass cube without collision: handy in bends.
book.steveparty.guide.board.spawn_bubble:
Where a space's mob appears, and where it looks.\
\
Link the space to the bubble with the [#](1C4E80)**Linker Brush**[#]().

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() with the [#](1C4E80)**Wrench**[#]().
- [#](1C4E80)**On arrival**[#](): the mob comes on a stop
- [#](1C4E80)**Always visible**[#](): it lives on the board
- [#](1C4E80)**Height**[#](): -4 to +8
No bubble: next to its space. [#](9A6A00)Sneak + Wrench[#](): turns 22.5°.
book.steveparty.guide.board.stamping.des: Give a tile its own look
book.steveparty.guide.board.stamping.pag:
[#](1C4E80)**Stencil**[#]() + [#](1C4E80)**dye**[#]() (one per hand), [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() a tile: pattern printed.\
\
Cost: 1 dye.

- [#](1C4E80)**Wet sponge**[#](): erases the stamp
- [#](1C4E80)**Dye**[#](): colours the active cartridge
- [#](1C4E80)**Glow ink**[#](): the tile glows; [#](1C4E80)**ink**[#](): off
book.steveparty.guide.board.wrench.name: Wrench
book.steveparty.guide.board.wrench.page1: It also sets podiums, poles and bubbles, and breaks plastic in one hit.
book.steveparty.guide.board.wrench.page2:
- [#](1C4E80)**Picker**[#](): copies a cartridge's destinations onto others
- Another cartridge in off hand: swapped, links kept
book.steveparty.guide.board.wrench.page3:
[#](9A6A00)Sneak + right-click[#]() a block: its settings are copied.
- Then on a block of the same type: pasted
- In the air: the Wrench is cleared
- Settings only: no items, no links
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.advance:
A token ending here moves on 1 to 6 spaces:\
[#](23933C)**forward**[#]() or [#](E23C9A)**back**[#]().

- [#](9A6A00)Sneak + scroll[#](), cartridge in hand: number and direction
- A [#](1C4E80)**Boomcart**[#]() pushes or rams the token
- No chaining
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.cartrid: A [#](1C4E80)**Cartridge**[#]() gives a space its role and its destinations.

Cartridge in hand, [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() a block: it becomes a destination. Again: removed.

- 1 destination: a set path
- several: the player picks
- none: the token stops

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() the air, cartridge in hand.\
\
Or open its space with the [#](1C4E80)**Wrench**[#](): the menu shows beside it.
Each role: this cartridge + one ingredient.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.invento: The token ends here: its player [#](2E7D32)**gets**[#]() or [#](C0392B)**loses**[#]() items.

- [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() a chest: linked (up to 8)
- Its menu: 9 items, [#](9A6A00)scroll[#]() sets the count
- Below 1: [#](C0392B)**negative**[#](), the item is taken

No linked chest: the [#](1C4E80)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage.

- [#](2F7FE0)**Blue**[#](): bonus
- [#](C0392B)**Red**[#](): penalty
- [#](D2691E)**Orange**[#](): nothing to give
Blue and red = teams A and B.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.key_gat: Gates [#](109090)**lock**[#]() some of the space's exits.

A locked exit needs a [#](1C4E80)**Gate Key**[#]().

- Use it: spent, the gate opens
- No key: wait, replay the move or go back to start

- Each exit: [#](2E7D32)**Free**[#]() or [#](C0392B)**Key**[#]()
- Open for how many turns: [#](1C4E80)**0**[#]() closes again, [#](1C4E80)**10**[#]() forever
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.mistigr: A token stops here: the [#](1C4E80)**Mistigri**[#]()'s roulette draws a **sentence**.

- [#](C0392B)**Steal**[#](): coins or stars
- [#](C0392B)**Redistribute**[#](): to others, poorest first
- [#](C0392B)**Back**[#](): 1 to 9 spaces
- [#](C0392B)**Cursed die**[#](): next roll 1 to 3
- [#](2E7D32)**Pity**[#](): coins given

- Up to **12** sentences
- Each: type, target, number or %%, **weight** 0 to 9
- **Cards**: how many go on the roulette

[#](C0392B)**Stolen**[#]() goods go to the [#](1C4E80)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage.\
\
[#](2E7D32)**Pity**[#]() draws from it.
The [#](1C4E80)**Mistigri's Die**[#]() drops from a Mistigri.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.name: Cartridges
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.pot.des: Feed the pot, win the pot
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.pot.pag: Passers [#](C0392B)**stake**[#](), whoever [#](2E7D32)**stops**[#]() wins the whole pot.

The pot is the coins in a [#](1C4E80)**Magpie Nest**[#]().\
\
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() the nest with the cartridge to link it. A magpie fetches the stakes.

- [#](1C4E80)**Stake**[#](): 0 to 100 (default 1)
- [#](1C4E80)**Base**[#](): coins put back after each win
- [#](1C4E80)**Max**[#](): the cap
A token ends here on its turn: its player [#](2E7D32)**rolls again**[#]() at once.\
\
This extra turn never gives another.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.shop.pa: The token ends here: a [#](1C4E80)**Boxed Trader**[#]() opens shop.

- [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() the trader, or [#](9A6A00)[Open the shop][#]() in the chat
- Closes by itself after 60 s
- In a checkpoint: every token passing stops

- Its menu: up to [#](1C4E80)**9 offers**[#]()
- [#](9A6A00)Sneak + scroll[#](): purchases per stop
- Stock: its linked chests, else the [#](1C4E80)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage
Steal the [#](1C4E80)**Bandana**[#]() from a trader with shears.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.star.pa: The star waits on a [#](C8A000)**Star**[#]() space, held by a [#](1C4E80)**Mula**[#]().

A token reaching it stops. In the chat:\
[#](9A6A00)[Buy][#]()\
[#](9A6A00)[No thanks][#]()\
\
No answer in 15 s: bought. Then the star moves on.

- The [#](1C4E80)**price**[#]()
- Sold when passing or only when stopping
- Leaves a space turned off by redstone, or not

The star comes from the [#](1C4E80)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage; the coins paid go there.\
\
[#](C0392B)**No star in storage: nothing is sold.**[#]()
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.start.p:
A token set on a [#](4C9A2A)**Start**[#]() space binds to it.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() empty-handed: token and space are yours.
The [#](1C4E80)**Party Controller**[#]() only takes bound tokens. Hit a token to unbind it.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.stop.pa: A token reaching a [#](454B5A)**Stop**[#]() space [#](C0392B)**ends**[#]() its move, steps left are lost.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.telepor: The token ends here: it jumps to another [#](8E4BFF)**Teleport**[#]() space of the same colour.

- [#](8E4BFF)**Violet**[#]() (default), [#](2E7D32)**green**[#](), [#](D2691E)**orange**[#](), [#](2F7FE0)**blue**[#]()
- A dye on the space changes its network
- Its menu: random or in turn
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.thresho: A wall: the token only gets through if [#](557799)**its roll**[#]() meets the condition.

Failed: the token [#](C0392B)**stops here**[#]() and loses its steps.\
\
Default: [#](2E7D32)**7 or more**[#]().

- [#](1C4E80)**Condition**[#](): ≥ ≤ > < = 1 to 30, Double, Triple
- [#](1C4E80)**Passage**[#](): tested each time
- [#](1C4E80)**Barrier**[#](): blocked, retry every turn
- [#](1C4E80)**Opening**[#](): for all, or per token
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.trichau: Pick a head, win its prize
A token stops here: the [#](EA600C)**Tricauldron**[#]() rises, [#](2E7D32)**one head per prize**[#]().

[#](9A6A00)Hit[#]() or [#](9A6A00)click[#]() a head: it spits its prize at you.\
\
30 s, else at random.

- [#](1C4E80)**Prizes**[#](): up to 5 items
- [#](1C4E80)**Consumed**[#]() or [#](1C4E80)**Permanent**[#]()
- [#](1C4E80)**Blind**[#]() or [#](1C4E80)**True choice**[#]()
- Taken from its linked chests, else the [#](1C4E80)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.wicklin: A token stops here: a [#](3B1FB8)**Wickling**[#]() robs the victim of your choice.

Never more than the victim has.

- [#](C0392B)**Coins**[#](): 7 s to hit it, each hit takes one back
- [#](C0392B)**Stars**[#](): no defence
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.boomcart: A grumpy cart full of TNT
A grumpy living minecart, in mineshafts.

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() with the other: it swaps.

- [#](C0392B)**TNT**[#](): a real explosion
- [#](1C4E80)**Rocket**[#](): a burst of stars, harmless

[#](1C4E80)**Flint and steel**[#](): [#](C0392B)**8 s**[#]() to blast, it rushes to the nearest player.\
\
Another player relights it: [#](2E7D32)**+3 s**[#](), +2, +1.

[#](23933C)**Forward**[#]() space: it blasts the token on.\
[#](E23C9A)**Back**[#]() space: it rams it.\
\
No block broken, nobody hurt.
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.glandoui: A grumpy acorn, under oaks and in taigas.

Come close or annoy it: it stamps and [#](C0392B)**charges**[#]().\
\
It [#](2E7D32)**never hurts**[#](). Into a wall: dazed.

- [#](9A6A00)Jump[#]() on its hat: squashed
- Twice: it drops [#](1C4E80)**acorns**[#]()
- An acorn on farmland: a young one

Calm, they stack (max 5).

- [#](9A6A00)Hit[#]() the top: it flies off
- [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() empty-handed: you carry them
- [#](9A6A00)Left-click[#](): you throw one

Rarely, it loses its [#](1C4E80)**Acorn Hat**[#]().

- [#](2E7D32)**Young**[#](): fast
- [#](1C4E80)**Old mossy**[#](): never charges
- [#](2F7FE0)**Frosty**[#](): slides like a puck
A tower of [#](9A5A2A)**Slackorns**[#]() pushes the token a few spaces, with those it meets.

- [#](1C4E80)**Spaces**[#](): up to 50; below 0, [#](E23C9A)**backwards**[#]()
- Tower [#](1C4E80)**height**[#]()
- Each token met knocks one off
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.magpie.p:
In forests, in six colours.\
\
Hold [#](1C4E80)**seeds**[#](): they follow you.

By day, a magpie picks up a [#](1C4E80)**shiny item**[#]() on the ground and takes it to its nest.\
\
Never from your inventory.

Two magpies fed [#](1C4E80)**seeds**[#](): a [#](2E7D32)**chick**[#]().\
\
It takes the first free nest. Grown in 20 min.

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() with coins: stored. Empty hand: taken back.\
\
27 × 256. A comparator reads the pile.
Breaks fast with an axe or a hoe, contents kept.
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.mistigri: A fat black tomcat full of bad luck.

Near a [#](1C4E80)**witch hut**[#](), [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() a [#](1C4E80)**black cat**[#]() with a die.\
\
The die shows **1**: the cat becomes a [#](1C4E80)**Mistigri**[#]().

- Meeting its gaze: [#](C0392B)**Bad Luck**[#]() 1 min
- Hitting it: 2 min, and it gets angry
- [#](1C4E80)**Raw fish**[#]() calms it

- Knocks items off frames
- Sleeps on chests: [#](C0392B)**locked**[#]() while it sleeps
- Drops the [#](1C4E80)**Mistigri's Die**[#]()

[#](1C4E80)**Raw fish**[#](): 6 to 10.

- It follows you
- [#](2E7D32)**Luck**[#]() within 16 blocks
- Monsters miss 1 hit in 3
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.trichaud: A three-headed Nether turtle, a lava tank on its back.

- Empty bucket: [#](C0392B)**-1**[#]() lava bucket
- Lava bucket: [#](2E7D32)**+1**[#]()
- It drinks lava to refill

[#](1C4E80)**Neutral**[#](): when hit, each head aims, [#](C0392B)**locks its aim**[#](), then spits.\
\
Dodge at the last moment, or raise a [#](1C4E80)**shield**[#]().

[#](C0392B)**Empty**[#]() its tank with buckets, then ride it.\
\
Empty: [#](2E7D32)**70%%**[#]() on the first try. [#](2E7D32)**+10%%**[#]() per failure.

- A [#](1C4E80)**saddle**[#](), up to 3 players
- Each holds a head
- Everyone's keys add up
- Its lava is its fuel

- Hold [#](9A6A00)jump[#](), release: a 15-block leap
- In the air, [#](9A6A00)click[#](): it grabs a wall
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.wickling: A candle ghost of the caves

A candle ghost of deep caves.\
\
No monster within [#](2E7D32)**8 blocks**[#]().

It steals [#](C0392B)**a shiny item**[#]() from whoever passes within 2 blocks.\
\
Never from someone with a torch, a lantern, or a Wickling.

- Hits: it reappears further away
- Projectiles: fly through it
- Potions: hurt it
- [#](1C4E80)**Flint and steel**[#](): gives the loot back, then tamed [#](2E7D32)**1 in 3**[#]()

- It lights the dark for you
- Cobwebs: no more slowdown
- [#](9A6A00)Click[#](): it follows you
- [#](9A6A00)Sneak + click[#](): [#](1C4E80)**Candle Holder**[#]()
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.buildin: [#](1C4E80)**Polished terracotta**[#]() and [#](1C4E80)**polished concrete**[#](): 8 shapes per colour.
Two polished blocks of different colours in a 2×2 checker: 4 [#](1C4E80)**tiles**[#]().
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.floatin:
It rises in water and rides [#](1C4E80)**bubble columns**[#](), with whatever is on top.\
\
A [#](1C4E80)**chain**[#]() holds it.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.hop_swi: Jump on it: its target blocks [#](1C4E80)**vanish**[#]() or [#](1C4E80)**appear**[#]() for a while.
Link targets with the [#](1C4E80)**Linker Brush**[#](). A clock changes the time.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.name: Decoration & Gadgets
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.paintin:
- [#](1C4E80)**Dye**[#](): repaints
- [#](1C4E80)**Glow ink**[#](): glows at night
- [#](1C4E80)**Sponge**[#](): no more glow
- [#](1C4E80)**Wet sponge**[#](): erases all
- [#](1C4E80)**Brush**[#](): fades, gone on the 5th stroke
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.pipes.p: Enter a mouth: you come out another end, at random.
A pipe into a block: to the nearest mouth of the same colour.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.plastic:
Toy blocks in 16 colours. Same-colour neighbours [#](1C4E80)**merge**[#]().\
\
The [#](1C4E80)**Wrench**[#]() breaks them in one hit.

- [#](1C4E80)**Stud**[#](): on floor, wall, ceiling
- [#](1C4E80)**Slabs, stairs, walls**[#]()
- [#](1C4E80)**Plastic Stick**[#]()
- [#](1C4E80)**Fence**[#](): holds road signs
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.signs.p: Five signs for your symbols, 16 directions.

- [#](1C4E80)**Easel Sign**[#](): on the floor
- [#](1C4E80)**Wooden Panel**[#]()
- [#](1C4E80)**Cut-Out Wooden Panel**[#]()
- [#](1C4E80)**Rock Sign**[#]()
- [#](1C4E80)**Plastic Road Sign**[#]()
[#](9A6A00)Sneak + click[#]() a fence or a wall: set on top or hung.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.stencil:
[#](9A6A00)Left-click[#](): cuts a pixel. [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#](): fills it.\
\
Your [#](1C4E80)**library**[#]() keeps 128 patterns.

A 16×16 pattern. [#](1C4E80)**Stencil**[#]() + [#](1C4E80)**dye**[#](): [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() a face to paint.\
\
Never used up.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.bubbler.pa: Step on it: a [#](1C4E80)**soap bubble**[#]() takes you 30 blocks up.

Hold [#](9A6A00)jump[#]() then release: the bubble dashes where you look.\
\
[#](C0392B)**Too many puffs**[#](): it strains and may burst.\
\
Idle, it slowly rises.

[#](9A6A00)Sneak[#](): you get out. Then slow falling.\
\
It bursts:
- against a block, a mob, a player
- under an arrow
- [#](C0392B)**too high**[#](): you fall, bring a parachute!

Two bubbles touching [#](2E7D32)**merge**[#]() (8 passengers).\
\
Shooting from inside: the target gets trapped in a bubble.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.looting_bo:
Hit it [#](9A6A00)with your head[#](), from below: it drops items.\
\
Its [#](B95D05)**Inventory Cartridge**[#]() says which.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.plunger.pa: [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() a mob: [#](C0392B)**silence**[#]()! Again: it gets its voice back.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.shoes.name: Triple Jump Shoes
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.shoes.page:
Jump again right after landing: [#](2E7D32)**×1.5**[#](), then [#](2E7D32)**×2**[#]().\
\
Jump against a wall: you kick off it.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.villager_m:
A [#](1C4E80)**Villager Block**[#]() reacts to 70 things, with 16 faces.\
\
Give it [#](2E7D32)**bread**[#]() or a [#](2E7D32)**flower**[#](). Click it 10 times: it sees stars.
book.steveparty.guide.getting_started.fi: Six steps to a working board

1. Lay [#](1C4E80)**Tiles**[#]() as a path
2. Link them with the [#](1C4E80)**Linker Brush**[#]()
3. The first one with a [#](4C9A2A)**Start Cartridge**[#]()

4. A mob as a token: [#](1C4E80)**Tokenizer Wand**[#]()
5. Place a [#](1C4E80)**Party Controller**[#]()
6. [#](9A6A00)Start the party[#](), then roll a [#](1C4E80)**die**[#]()!
Each step has its tab: **The board**, **Cartridges**, **Tokens and dice**, **Running a party**.
book.steveparty.guide.getting_started.pl: The first ingredient of almost everything

The first ingredient of almost everything.\
\
[#](1C4E80)**Sugar cane**[#]() in a furnace = pellets.
Start a sugar cane farm early!
book.steveparty.guide.getting_started.we: What Steve Party Maker is about

Build a [#](1C4E80)**board**[#](), turn mobs into [#](1C4E80)**tokens**[#](), roll the [#](1C4E80)**dice**[#]() and win [#](C8A000)**stars**[#]().\
\
In survival, and nearly all of it with redstone.

- Entries open as you play
- [#](C0392B)**Locked**[#](): says how to open it
- Every item: creative tab
book.steveparty.guide.lock.dice_forge: Place a Dice Forge to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.lay_the_board: Place a Tile to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.make_a_pawn: Get a Tokenizer Wand or a Token to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.mini_games: Get a Mini-Game Page or place a Mini-game Controller to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.open_shop: Get a Shopkeeper Key or place a Trading Stall to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.party_time: Place a Party Controller to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.roll_the_dice: Get a die to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.stardust: Get a star fragment to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.entranc: An entrance outside parties: [#](9A6A00)click it[#]() with the page, the page stays yours. Then link pipes.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.formats:
They come from the board:
- [#](2F7FE0)**Team A**[#](): on a blue space
- [#](C0392B)**Team B**[#](): on a red space
- the others fill in
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.mg_cont: Place it in the arena, [#](9A6A00)click it[#]() with the [#](1C4E80)**Mini-Game Page**[#](). Then the [#](9A6A00)brush[#]() links its pipes and podiums.

Outside a party, [#](9A6A00)Play[#](): no gains.

- [#](C0392B)**Red**[#](): idle
- [#](D2691E)**Orange**[#](): trial round
- [#](2E7D32)**Green**[#](): real round

Same teams, no gains, until everyone is ready.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Y[#]() or [#](9A6A00)Ready[#]().
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.name: Mini-games
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.pages.p: A page describes a mini-game. [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() the air: its editor.
Keep them in a [#](1C4E80)**Mini Games Catalogue**[#](), in the [#](1C4E80)**Party Controller**[#]().
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.pipe_ro:
[#](1C4E80)**Mini-Game Page**[#]() in hand, [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() a pipe mouth: the pipe is linked.\
\
Its colour is its role.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.podiums: The taller the column, the better the place.\n\nGold, iron, copper: [#](9A6A00)click[#]() or [#](9A6A00)sneak[#]() on it.
[#](9A6A00)Click[#]() with the page: the mini-game ends when every place is taken.\n\n[#](9A6A00)Wrench[#](): this podium, best place, last place.
[#](C0392B)**Redstone Podium**[#](): a pulse, the nearest player.\n\nA dye on its carpet: its colour.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.zone.pa:
Page editor: [#](9A6A00)Draw the zone[#](), then two corners.

- [#](1C4E80)**Restore**[#](): the arena is put back
- [#](1C4E80)**Adventure**[#](): no blocks broken or placed
book.steveparty.guide.name: Steve Party Maker Guide
book.steveparty.guide.party.bell.name: Party Antenna
book.steveparty.guide.party.bell.page0.t:
Redstone at the right moment.\
\
Linked with the [#](1C4E80)**Tile Linker Brush**[#]() to an element of a party (Party Controller, a space...): it listens to that party. Not linked: nothing.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Right-click with the Wrench[#](): what it listens to.
book.steveparty.guide.party.bell.page1.t:
- [#](9A6A00)**Party**[#](): start, final rounds, end, rewind
- [#](1C7FA0)**Rounds and turns**[#](): round, turn, die, fork, path, landing
- [#](267C3E)**Coins and stars**[#](): coins, Party Stars, leader
- [#](7B2AA0)**Events**[#](): event, its end
- [#](C0601A)**Mini-games**[#](): chosen, practice, start, end

Comparator: a related number.
book.steveparty.guide.party.bell.page3.t:
[#](1C4E80)**Filter**[#](): rings only for some values (= 5, ≥ 3...).

[#](1C4E80)**Wait**[#](): the party pauses until every waiting antenna gets redstone; a Party Rewinder's Next goes on.
book.steveparty.guide.party.bell.page2.t: Parachute as the dish, redstone torch as the receiver, lightning rod as the mast.
book.steveparty.guide.party.cards.name: Party Cards
Your program, **Program** tab, left to right.
- [#](1C4E80)**Turns**[#](): each token plays once
- [#](1C4E80)**Mini-game**[#](): one from the catalogue
- [#](1C4E80)**Event**[#](): pings the Party Antennas set to Event
- [#](1C4E80)**Repeat**[#](): replays from the [#](1C4E80)**Sequence start**[#]()
Stud of the colour + paper + redstone = 4 cards.
book.steveparty.guide.party.controller.p: It runs the party. [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#](): its dashboard.

- **Status**: what's missing, then the party
- **Players**: tokens, stars, coins
- **Program**: mini-games and cards
- **Gains** · **Storage** · **Settings**

It takes the tokens of the [#](4C9A2A)**Starts**[#]() linked with the [#](1C4E80)**Linker Brush**[#]().\
\
[#](9A6A00)Start the party[#](), or a redstone signal.

[#](9A6A00)Stop the party[#]() (**Status** tab): ends it [#](C0392B)**with no winner**[#]().\
\
Tokens go back to start.\
\
Only an operator or a Game Master.

On: only the dice in its slots can be rolled.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Click[#]() with a die: added. Empty hand: removed.
Comparator: 0 idle, 1 setup, 2 turn, 3 mini-game, 4 antenna, 5 end.
book.steveparty.guide.party.flow.descrip: From the first roll to the podium
book.steveparty.guide.party.flow.name: How a Party Plays
book.steveparty.guide.party.flow.page0.t:
1. Bound tokens join
2. One roll each: highest starts
3. Your turn: roll, move
4. Then a mini-game
5. End: tokens are freed
book.steveparty.guide.party.flow.page1.t:
A missing token: its turn waits 60 s, then [#](9A6A00)[Skip the turn][#]() or [#](9A6A00)[Exclude from the party][#]().\
\
[#](9A6A00)M[#]() arranges the HUD, [#](9A6A00)H[#]() hides it.
book.steveparty.guide.party.goal_pole.de: Jump to the top and score
book.steveparty.guide.party.goal_pole.pa: Land on top: [#](2E7D32)**+1 ♥**[#]() and a point.

- A [#](1C4E80)**Goal Pole Base**[#]()
- [#](1C4E80)**Goal Pole**[#]() segments on it
- The [#](1C4E80)**Flag**[#]() goes to the top

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() the pole: the goal.\
\
Reached, the flag comes down. Dye: colour. Shears: removed.

- Comparator on the base: a pulse per point
- Against the pole: progress 0 to 15
- Signal into the base: pause; 15: reset
3 wool in a corner; 1 to 8 dyes change it.
book.steveparty.guide.party.name: Running a Party
book.steveparty.guide.party.piggy_bank.d: Give and take on a pulse
book.steveparty.guide.party.piggy_bank.p: On each pulse: its [#](B95D05)**Inventory Cartridge**[#]() [#](2E7D32)**gives**[#]() or [#](C0392B)**takes**[#]().

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#](): its menu.
- the player whose turn it is
- the last winners
- everyone
- the nearest

Linked with the [#](1C4E80)**Tile Linker Brush**[#]() to an element of a party (Party Controller, a space...): that party, even far away.\
\
Not linked: it does nothing; its panel and its menu show the brush crossed out in red.
book.steveparty.guide.party.powerups.pag:
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() at the start of your turn, **before your roll**.\
\
**One** per turn.

- [#](1C4E80)**Mushroom**[#](): [#](2E7D32)**+3**[#]() to the roll
- [#](1C4E80)**Double Coins**[#](): gains [#](2E7D32)**×2**[#]()
- [#](1C4E80)**Padlock**[#](): blocks a theft or a trap

- [#](1C4E80)**Thief Bell**[#](): steals [#](C0392B)**5 to 15**[#]() coins
- [#](1C4E80)**Golden Thief Bell**[#](): steals [#](C0392B)**1 star**[#]()
- [#](1C4E80)**Trap**[#](): set on your space, the next one [#](2E7D32)**pays you**[#]()

[#](9A6A00)Sneak + right-click[#](): write and sign it.\
\
Pick:
- coins [#](C0392B)**stolen**[#]()
- [#](C0392B)**move back**[#]()
- [#](C0392B)**turn lost**[#]()
- an item [#](C0392B)**stolen**[#]()

- [#](1C4E80)**Star Whistle**[#](): the star moves
- [#](1C4E80)**Golden Pipe**[#](): your token right [#](2E7D32)**before the star**[#]()

[#](1C4E80)**3**[#]() power-ups carried at most (**Max power-ups**, Settings).\
\
Dice with the power-up module count too.

Easy to craft. The board's maker sells them: stall, [#](5E8C0F)**Shop**[#]() space, [#](B95D05)**Inventory**[#]() space…\
\
Suggested prices: [#](1C4E80)**5**[#]() to [#](1C4E80)**40**[#]() coins.
book.steveparty.guide.party.rewards.name: Coins, Stars & Rewards
book.steveparty.guide.party.rewards.page:
A player's coins and stars are those [#](1C4E80)**items**[#]() in their inventory.\
\
Ranking: stars, then coins.

By default: the [#](1C4E80)**Coin**[#]() and the [#](C8A000)**Party Star**[#]().\
\
**Gains** tab: [#](9A6A00)click[#]() their slot with an item to change them.

**Storage** tab: 27 slots + its linked chests.

- What the party [#](2E7D32)**pays**[#]() comes out of it
- What it [#](C0392B)**takes**[#]() goes back in
- [#](C0392B)**Empty**[#](): nothing is paid
book.steveparty.guide.party.step_control:
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() a button: picks the mode.

[#](1C4E80)**Previous**[#]() · [#](9A6A00)**Replay**[#]() · [#](2E7D32)**Next**[#]()

[#](C0392B)**Redstone**[#]() pulse: runs the chosen mode.

- [#](1C4E80)**Previous**[#](): back to the turn before
- [#](9A6A00)**Replay**[#](): the turn restarts; trial round or mini-game: again
- [#](2E7D32)**Next**[#](): moves on (turn not rolled, antenna, trial → real round, mini-game → end)

Linked with the [#](1C4E80)**Tile Linker Brush**[#]() to an element of a party (Party Controller, a space...): that party, even far away.\
\
Otherwise: the closest within 64 blocks.

The pawn goes back, and what the game gave or took [#](2E7D32)**goes back**[#]() where it came from.

What was used, thrown or given away [#](C0392B)**isn't given back**[#](): the chat says so.

Doesn't undo what you trigger yourself (redstone, commands).
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.dice.pa:
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#](): the die flies above the nearest mob.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Hit it[#]() to stop it.

Only the token whose turn it is moves, and **one roll**.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Sneak[#](): the die aims at the nearest player.

- [#](1C4E80)**Simple Die**[#](): 1 to 10
- [#](1C4E80)**Double Dice**[#](): 2 to 20
- [#](1C4E80)**Triple Dice**[#](): 3 to 30
- [#](1C4E80)**Forged Die**[#](): its own faces
The die comes back 2 s after its result.
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.faces.p:
For the [#](1C4E80)**Dice Forge**[#]().\
\
The [#](1C4E80)**stonecutter**[#]() turns a blank face into any number.
On a forged die, a blank face is 0.

The token doesn't move.
- [#](1C4E80)**0**[#](): stay, replay the space
- [#](2E7D32)**+1 to +10**[#](): coins won
- [#](C0392B)**−1 to −10**[#](): coins lost
- [#](1C4E80)**Swap**[#](): swap with a token
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.game_ma:
A treasure enchantment for the [#](1C4E80)**Tokenizer Wand**[#](): mansions, evokers, illusioners.

- Resizes anyone's token
- Can exclude a token from a party
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.modules:
A module acts on the whole die.\
\
Recipe: 7 fragments of its colour + 1 ingredient.

- [#](1C4E80)**Slow**[#](): aim the face
- [#](1C4E80)**Choice**[#](): pick the face
- [#](1C4E80)**Lucky**[#](): keep the best
- [#](1C4E80)**Reroll**[#](): keep or reroll
- [#](1C4E80)**Power-up**[#](): single use

Add them at a crafting table or the forge.

- [#](C0392B)**Reversed**[#](): the token goes back
- [#](1C4E80)**Skeleton Key**[#](): ignores Stop and shops
- [#](1C4E80)**Homing**[#](): random forks
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.name: Pawns & Dice
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.pawns.p:
A figurine: no AI, silent, [#](2E7D32)**invulnerable**[#]().

- Its name: the mob's, or yours
- Its colour tints its base
- A dye changes it
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.token.p: Stores your token to move it by hand.

- Empty token, [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() your token: stored
- Full token, [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() a block: placed
- On a [#](4C9A2A)**Start**[#](): joins the party
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.wand.de: Any mob can be a pawn
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.wand.pa:
Draw a circle around the mob:
- on the guide: a [#](1C4E80)**1-block**[#]() token
- bigger: up to [#](1C4E80)**2 blocks**[#]()
- smaller: down to [#](1C4E80)**0.25**[#]()

[#](9A6A00)Hold right-click[#]() in the air: a wisp up to 32 blocks.\
\
[#](C0392B)**No Dragon, no Wither.**[#]()
book.steveparty.guide.shops.bandanas.pag:
[#](1C4E80)**Shears**[#]() on an open trader: you steal its [#](1C4E80)**Bandana**[#]().\
\
With a bandana, traders ignore you.

Shear a bald trader again: a [#](1C4E80)**Box Costume**[#]().\
\
[#](9A6A00)Sneak[#](): you hide inside like a block.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.name: Shops
book.steveparty.guide.shops.overview.pag: Four parts, linked to the same trader with the [#](1C4E80)**Shopkeeper Key**[#]().

- [#](1C4E80)**Boxed Trader**[#](): the seller
- [#](1C4E80)**Stall**[#](): the offers
- [#](1C4E80)**Chests**[#](): the stock
- [#](1C4E80)**Register**[#](): the money

These shops: free trade between players, outside parties.\
\
On a board: the [#](5E8C0F)**Shop**[#]() space.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.owners.name: Owners & Protection
book.steveparty.guide.shops.owners.page0:
The first to link a key to the trader.

- Only they open stall, register and stock
- Explosions spare the shop
- One customer at a time
book.steveparty.guide.shops.register.pag:
Payments go there, register by register.\
\
Full: they drop, [#](2E7D32)**never lost**[#]().
A redstone pulse on each sale.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.stall.name: Trading Stall
A column = an offer (up to 9): the item, then [#](1C4E80)**Price 1**[#]() and [#](1C4E80)**Price 2**[#]().
The item is only a model: each sale takes it from the linked chests.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.trader.descr: A villager hidden in a box
book.steveparty.guide.shops.trader.name: Boxed Trader
book.steveparty.guide.shops.trader.page0:
A villager hiding in a box.

- It peeks out within 15 blocks
- [#](9A6A00)Sneaking[#](): it doesn't see you
- Linked to a key: it stays put
book.steveparty.guide.shops.villager_blo: A [#](1C4E80)**downward piston**[#]() on a villager's head: squashed into a block, alive.

Place it on the block to copy, then [#](9A6A00)fall on it[#]() from high up.\
\
A [#](1C4E80)**Boxed Trader**[#]() comes out, disguised.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.dice_fo:
Engrave your own dice.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() with a [#](1C4E80)**Gravity Core**[#]() to wake it.

- [#](1C4E80)**12 faces**[#](): the stack = the weight
- [#](1C4E80)**5 fragments**[#](), different colours
- [#](1C4E80)**Blank faces**[#](): one per face
- [#](1C4E80)**5 modules**[#]()
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.ephemer:
A night of shooting stars.

- [#](2E7D32)**25%%**[#]() at full moon
- Never at new moon
- Then [#](1C4E80)**3 to 5 Mulas**[#]() fall 150-600 blocks away
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.forging:
[#](9A6A00)FORGE[#](): a die every [#](1C4E80)**5 s**[#](), as long as there is enough.\
\
Hoppers in on top and sides, dice out below.

It draws a face by its weight.

- Engraved 10 times: 10 times as often
- One face only: a loaded die
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.fragmen: 16 colours. [#](1C4E80)**Mulas**[#]() drop 6; the others mix like dyes.
9 fragments: a glowing block. Brewed: [#](1C4E80)**potion of luck**[#]().
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.gravity:
Placed, it [#](1C4E80)**pulls**[#]() everything within 8 blocks into orbit.\
\
It wakes the [#](1C4E80)**Dice Forge**[#]().

- No fall damage
- [#](9A6A00)Sneak[#](): you slow down
- Iron armour resists
- Mulas and tokens never pulled
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.mula.pa:
It falls from the sky on [#](1C4E80)**Ephemeris**[#]() nights, or hatches from an egg.\
\
[#](2F7FE0)**Blue**[#](), [#](C0392B)**red**[#](), [#](2E7D32)**green**[#](), [#](C8A000)**yellow**[#](), [#](8E4BFF)**violet**[#](); rarely [#](23202A)**black**[#]().

Only food of [#](1C4E80)**its colour**[#]() (see the tooltip).\
\
Full (40), it [#](2E7D32)**bursts**[#](): [#](2E7D32)**64 star fragments**[#](), then is reborn further away.
On a [#](C8A000)**Star**[#]() space, a Mula holds the star and hands it to the token that arrives.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.mula_ho:
A forge with its core: the [#](1C4E80)**home**[#]() of Mulas within 16 blocks.\
\
They [#](2E7D32)**dance**[#]() around the core: ten figures.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.name: Stars & Creatures
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.party_s:
A party's default [#](C8A000)**star**[#]().\
\
One fragment of each colour, or 5 black ones.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.rising_:
More fragments in the forge, the higher the core.\
\
At the top: [#](2E7D32)**max level**[#](), an Ephemeris [#](2E7D32)**guaranteed**[#]() at full moon.

- Raised, it pulls up to 32 blocks
- Hit, it [#](C0392B)**explodes**[#](): core lost
- [#](9A6A00)Sneak empty-handed[#](): taken back safely
A fragment of [#](1C4E80)**its colour**[#](): [#](2E7D32)**1 chance in 3**[#]().

- Follows you like a balloon
- [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() empty-handed: sits
- At night, on a [#](1C4E80)**lead**[#](), they lift you into the sky
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.telesco:
At night, clear sky, [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() it.

- [#](9A6A00)Scroll[#](): a night
- Keep a shooting star in the sight
- A [#](2E7D32)**guide star**[#]() shows where the Mulas fell
book.steveparty.guide.tooltip: Build a board, run a party, tame a Mula.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.end.des: The finish line of the board
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.end.pag:
A pawn reaching it [#](D94F70)**stops**[#]() and the party heads for its **end**.

Then: the turn played out, a stop, one last turn, or the arrived ones [#](D94F70)**wait**[#]() for all.

**Tile Linker Brush**: from the Party Controller to a Finish space.

Once the party is over, the pawns gather there; several on one space turn round, small.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.event.d: A time out for your redstone
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.event.p:
A pawn stopping on it starts a [#](9B6BE0)**time out**[#]().

The Party Antennas set to **Event** catch it: your redstone and commands take over.

**Tile Linker Brush**: from the space to pipes, the players come out of them.

It ends with the [#](9B6BE0)**hourglass**[#](), a waiting antenna or a Party Rewinder: everyone comes back.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.minigam: A pawn stopping on it starts a [#](F08A24)**mini-game**[#]() right after its turn, from the catalogue, or always the page put in its menu.

- [#](F08A24)**1 vs 1**[#](): against a player he picks, or a random one
- **1 vs all**, **FFA**, **Teams**
- Several on: its player picks in the chat
Hold it while falling: it [#](1C4E80)**opens**[#]() by itself. You float down, steering with your keys, no fall damage.

[#](9A6A00)Use[#]() in the air: open or fold it.\
\
It folds when you land, swim or glide with an elytra.

[#](9A6A00)Use[#]() it on a mob: it opens when the mob falls and drops off after landing.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Sneak[#]() empty-handed on the mob: you take it back.
Dye it: its stripes take the colour. Repair it with wool or string.
